laws.rule: Severe penalties for even small amounts of illegal drugs. A personal supply of a controlled drug (for example methylphenidate for ADHD, codeine or morphine) has specific legal requirements: check with the Ministry of Health before travel.

Sale and import of vapes and e-cigarettes are banned. Visitors over 21 may bring one device and up to 30 ml of e-liquid, and must take it with them or surrender it to the Ministry of Health on departure.
Drive on an Australian licence for up to 6 months, only vehicles your licence covers. A scooter needs a temporary motorbike licence: a practical test at police headquarters in Avarua.

culture-and-protocol.dress_and_conduct: Modest dress and behaviour, especially outside resorts, in villages and on the outer islands. Visitors are welcome at Sunday services: shirts and long trousers for men, longer skirts or dresses for women, shoulders covered. Cook Islands Tourism: dress modestly in villages, town and churches. For Sunday service, men wear a shirt and long trousers; women wear a dress or skirt to the knee or longer, with shoulders covered. Visitors are welcome at services. No topless or nude sunbathing. On Mitiaro, no photos during Sunday service.

unpaid-speaking.detail: Rechecked 3 November 2026: Cook Islands Immigration's visa and permit criteria (Cook Islands Regulations 2023) give Australians a visitor permit on arrival for stays under 3 months, on condition of being a bona fide visitor not intending to work for gain or reward or study; the page doesn't name unpaid speaking. remote-work.route: Not a visitor activity on the wording; no remote-work class listed (Special Entrant Visa and Permit for purposes that fit no other class)
remote-work.detail: Cook Islands visitor permits are for bona fide visitors not intending to undertake work for gain or reward or study while in the Cook Islands. No digital nomad or remote-work class is listed. The Special Entrant Visa and Permit is for a genuine purpose that doesn't fit any other class, at Immigration's discretion, fee NZD 960 (about A$769 at the RBA rate of 30 October 2026, A$1 = NZD 1.2480).
remote-work.next: Ask Cook Islands Immigration in writing whether remote work for an overseas employer needs a Special Entrant permit.

mixed-mission.route: Visitor permit for unpaid parts; worker permit for any paid part
mixed-mission.detail: The visitor permit (under 3 months for Australians) covers a bona fide visit with no work for gain or reward or study. Any paid service needs a worker permit, such as the Specialist Worker Visa and Permit for a contract with a Cook Islands agency or business (NZD 260, about A$208 at the RBA rate of 30 October 2026, A$1 = NZD 1.2480). Research uses its own permit (see research).
mixed-mission.next: Split the plan into unpaid visitor parts and paid parts, and get the permit for the paid parts before travel.

volunteering.route: Government Worker Visa and Permit (volunteers on a government-endorsed programme); otherwise Special Entrant
volunteering.detail: The Government Worker Visa and Permit covers volunteers with an agreement with the government agency, or with the business or incorporated society supporting a government-endorsed programme, plus a letter of support from that agency. Fees are NZD 320 for 1 year (about A$256 at the RBA rate of 30 October 2026, A$1 = NZD 1.2480), NZD 640 for 2 years and NZD 960 for 3. Volunteering outside such a programme isn't named; the Special Entrant Visa and Permit covers purposes that fit no other class.
volunteering.next: Ask the host organisation for the agency's letter of support before applying online.

items.text: There are specific legal requirements that need to be met in order to bring into the Cook Islands a personal supply of a Controlled Drug (for example medicines for ADHD such as methylphenidate or strong pain medicines, such as codeine or morphine).
Penalties for carrying or using even small amounts of illegal drugs are severe.
The Cook Islands has banned the sale or importation of imitation tobacco products, including vapes/e-cigarettes.
Visitors over the age of 21 are allowed to bring one e-imitation tobacco device and up to 30 millilitres of e-liquid.

visa-preparation.entry_summary: Authorities issue a visa on arrival, generally a 31-day visitor visa. On application, visits of up to 8 months in total are possible. Show an onward or return ticket, enough funds and arranged accommodation.
visa-preparation.before_departure: Book an onward or return ticket and accommodation, and carry proof of funds. Anyone with a criminal conviction should contact the Ministry of Foreign Affairs and Immigration before travelling.
visa-preparation.useful_stay: Generally 31 days on arrival; up to 8 months in total on application.

steps.step: Arrive with an onward or return ticket, proof of enough funds and arranged accommodation; the visitor visa is issued on arrival.
To stay beyond the first visa, apply to the Ministry of Foreign Affairs and Immigration (up to 8 months in total).
With a criminal conviction, contact the Ministry before travel; not declaring can affect future travel.
